info.title: UniVerse API
info.description: Every error is `{ error: { code, message, requestId } }`. Unsafe methods need the `X-CSRF-Token` header from /api/auth/login or /api/auth/me.

MODULE_UNAVAILABLE.meaning: Another module or companion service is down or slow

INVALID_RECIPIENT.meaning: Internal exam call names a user who is not an active reviewer

INVALID_ACTOR.meaning: Internal exam audit actor is not an active reviewer

NOT_BOARDED.meaning: Only a rider who boarded, after pickup, may rate the ride

RIDE_CLOSED.meaning: The ride was cancelled, completed, started or reassigned

TIME_WINDOW_MISMATCH.meaning: The ride no longer fits the passenger's requested time

GROUP_ACCESS.meaning: Women-only ride or group (the code requestSeat already used)

DRIVER_SUSPENDED.meaning: The driver is suspended from rides

SEAT_OVERLAP.meaning: The rider already holds a seat at an overlapping time

IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED.meaning: The Idempotency-Key was used for a different request

NOT_A_MENTOR.meaning: Mentor action by someone who no longer mentors

errors.503: MODULE_UNAVAILABLE: the service is down or slow
